nodes.title: Land the positional firefly detector and the cv2-free frame reader on master
nodes.why: Owner ruling 2026-11-10, ADR-0002 decision 9: 'Two OpenCV branches are unmerged. (Please merge these).' Landed as 3c40d7aa (full stock suite 12,587 passed / 500 skipped / 11 xfailed / 0 failed) and recorded in 880d2cfc. retina/firefly_scan.py passes to NR-QC-FRAME-CONTRACT, which changes it next. The plan document's Status is stale and still proposes cv2 in hython (against R4); its owner corrects that.

nodes.title: Give the firefly scan a worker-side reader that reports frame positions and names its luminance basis
nodes.why: Slice 0: retina/ingest.py read_beauty returns no data-window origin and keeps every channel, while fireflies() refuses anything but 3 channels; the cv-side reader lives in python/synapse/cv/, which the worker does not carry. Owner ruling QC-Q1: a new reader file inside retina/, the luminance basis and reader named as check extras (make_check(**extra)), no edit to any NR-IMAGE-CONTRACT file. Done when a fixture whose data window does not start at the frame corner reports frame positions, and a 4-channel part is reduced to RGB or refused with a reason.

nodes.title: Time the read, the firefly scan and the mask write on real rendered frames, CPU first
nodes.why: v5.99.0 measured no speed, memory or latency figure (docs/releases/v5.99.0.md Limits). No budget (QC-Q3) and no GPU decision for this operation is defensible before a receipt with its producer command (Law 2). Frames are Joe's to name (QC-Q5). Reports read, scan and mask write separately, in the R4 CPU environment.

nodes.title: Show one render-QC finding in the Review face, built from the event with no model in the loop
nodes.why: A finding the artist cannot see is not a feature. Slice 0: FaceReview.set_receipt clears its box on every call and draws only check names, so a second event would replace T0's rows and no number could be drawn; verdict.py is two-state and unused by the Review face. The row states 'candidates', the count, the worst pixel in frame coordinates, its sigma and the mask path beside the frame (QC-Q4); inconclusive reads as inconclusive with the detector's note; a count of None never renders as 0. The signal from claude_worker.py is QC-OPEN-2.

nodes.title: One real Karma frame through the development seat in a GUI session, with the receipt committed
nodes.why: Every result so far is on constructed fixtures. One approved real frame (QC-Q5) on a scratch scene, Houdini preferences isolated, is the difference between built and seen. It runs on the development seat: no worker package exists until NR-PACKAGE-PAIR, which this amendment does not touch. It is the hand-off point to NR-VG-GPU-CANARY.

edges.why: the contract changes a detector that must first be on master
time the reader the worker will actually use
the worker's first operation is the firefly scan, and it needs frame positions
the row is fed by a terminal receipt, never by a bare result file
the live check is judged by what the row shows
the canary compares against a CPU result an artist has seen on a real frame
replaces the removed dep edge (QC-Q2): the worker records the basis it used, and NR-IMAGE-CONTRACT later fixes the basis; it no longer blocks the worker
